_doc: tools/brand_render.py renders hub/src/templates (+ partials) to hub/site with brand/brand.json. hub/site is generated: edit here, then run python3 tools/brand_render.py.

home._doc: home_design is hero-room (concept C, the default) or feed-first (concept A). Swapping is a one-line change of home_design, then a re-render, for A/B testing. hero_room is the featured room id on the Hero Room home. It can rotate so SubX does not read as a single-topic site.

index.html.description: {{brand.name}} is a home for small, single-topic {{brand.roomNoun.many}}. Highlights from live {{brand.roomNoun.many}}, each linking back to its {{brand.roomNoun.one}}. One {{brand.name}} account works on the hub and in every {{brand.roomNoun.one}}.

topics._doc: Topic pages from the seed (HOLD rows never render). open=false: hidden topics show the not-live-yet state. showDoorways=false: no 'Also reachable at' line. hubNoindex=false (go-live 2026-11-04): hub pages are index,follow unless their pages entry sets robots; every topic page keeps the hide-until-active rule (only status active is indexable or in the sitemap). Set hubNoindex=true to put every page back under noindex,nofollow with an empty sitemap.
